introHtml: Koozie stick on magnetic calendars combine the durability of a trusted brand with the convenience of a peel-and-stick design. These calendars adhere to metal surfaces like file cabinets or lockers, keeping your brand visible all year. With Koozie's reliable printing and a variety of layouts from monthly planners to desk pads, you can choose a style that fits your recipients' workspace. Ideal for trade shows, client gifts, or employee appreciation, these calendars offer daily brand exposure with a practical utility that ensures they won't be thrown away.
